38 |     bump(self.receive)

37 |     out := over(self.send, room)
   |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the live derived view
  = note: [0800]/[0830]: the `inout` parameter `c` locks its argument whether or not the routine writes it; finish with `out` before the call and take it again after, or, if the routine only reads it, declare `c` without `inout`
